descriptionByLocale.en:
Your tasks
• Creation and validation of energy billing
• Ensuring the correct application of tariffs, prices and contracts
• Ensuring the quality standards of energy billing
• Assumption of projects in operational operations (operational takeovers)
• Processing of group mailboxes
• Maintenance of ERP systems in the field of energy billing
• Processing of customer and partner inquiries for billing
• Assistance in the preparation and maintenance of internal documentation
• Further development of billing services and processes This is what you bring with you
• Commercial or technical basic training with corresponding further education
• Advantage: Knowledge of metrology, energy and water billing
• Experience with ERP or billing systems (e.g. Bexio, Abacus) is advantageous
• Very good knowledge of German and French, other languages are beneficial
• High affinity for numbers and analytical skills
• Independent, reliable and responsible working methods
• Strong service and customer orientation, strong communication and capable of teamwork; Entrepreneurial thinking and business understanding Questions about the job Lukas Stalder Head of Sales & Customer Service Sales & Customer Service & #43;41 41 229 30 92 We do not want requests from personnel service providers. We look forward to your online application. pi-System GmbH is a successful partner in the field of integral building automation based in Oberkirch. Our guiding principle is energy efficiency: economical use of energy and sustainable solutions.
